evidence_slice: North Yorkshire Council's adopted Hambleton Local Plan, adopted 22 February 2022, identifies housing allocation LEB1: Harkness Drive, Leeming Bar, for approximately 85 homes. The authority-hosted PlanningPolicy MapServer exposes layer 2 named Housing Allocations as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700, with GeoJSON query support and fields including POLICY_REFERENCE, SITEREF, ADDRESS, AREA_HA and POT_YIELD.
